relationshipEvidenceSemantics.explicit: The stated narrow relationship fact is explicit in an official profile; the proposed game edge is still a design choice.

importantQualifications: Every missing target named in exceptions was checked against all276 runtime forms, including the preserved forms absent from the255-sheet page.
An exception means this prototype has no reviewed continuation, not that canon forbids any evolution.
The optional Gotsumon→Meteormon route uses full Ultimate gates. It is not an immediate level1 power jump.
Conditional Kumamon route must not reinterpret the source as the unrelated official Hybrid Kumamon.
All11 early-stage sources have a proposed care-only escape from their stage; captured low stages need not grind weak battles to reach Rookie.
Cross-slice candidates are identified separately and not duplicated as owned proposals. Armor/item/mode policies remain with the late owner.
Adding incoming edges to preserved forms does not replace earlier routes or alter existing stats. Runtime family/legacy-save conversion is outside this proposal.
No proposed edge is justified solely by a requirement to eliminate every leaf; source-unavailable or ambiguous paths remain explicit.
